assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

On 2.x a session has no process of its own to exit and relaunch; its lifetime ends when it is archived and resumes when it is unarchived and prompted again — the record's mapping (archive, then unarchive and prompt the same ses_). The daemon's side, read from code: the 2.x reader lists only rows with time_archived IS NULL, so an archived session is reported gone (watcher_v2.go v2SessionGone → EventRemoved, recorded as transcript_removed) and its cursor dropped; the detector flips it to ready and keeps it (it is the newest root on the service pid, so the same-pid dedupe does not take it). After unarchive the next session_message write is admitted as activity again and the watcher re-emits the SAME session id (watcher_v2.go emitNewSession; the detector's existing-session path). So the resumed turn lands on the original row, not a new one.

## Spec choices

- Turn 1 on the ses_… session; the archive is a transcript_removed on it.
- After unarchive, activity and a full working → Stop hook → ready turn on the SAME session id.
caveats: The archive is the 2.x stand-in for the agent exiting: the service keeps running, so there is no process exit and the PID does not change — the scenario's 'new PID lifetime' has no 2.x counterpart.
Re-admission after unarchive was read from code (watcher_v2.go: the dropped cursor re-seeds on the first scan, the next write is activity); this recording is its first measurement.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
One turn, archive the session (PATCH {archived: true}), unarchive it, then a second turn on the same ses_… id
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: again. Do not use any tools.

verify: the archive is a transcript_removed on the session
after unarchive, turn 2 runs working → ready on the SAME ses_… id
